annotations.title: Make a look from a video she likes

description: Turns a video she likes into a look recipe (schema 2): pass reference_id (a style reference whose video the server studied) or url (an Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or Threads link; an Instagram link is added and studied through competitor_post_study). The server measures the video's color, caption and title type and motion, and cut rate, then saves a recipe under her styles with source agent and the link as source.ref. Fields it could not measure keep their default and are listed in not_measured; confidence says per section whether it was measured, guessed or left at the default. A study takes up to a minute: the call returns {state:"studying"} and you ask again in a few seconds. Asking again after it finished returns the same recipe. The cover GIF is queued; read it with recipe_get. Copy the pattern, never the footage or the words: the video is not placed in any edit and music is not taken.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

name.description: The look's name. Default: Inspired by @handle

url.description: A link to the video she likes

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
